classification.difficultyReason: Represent each named angle using a horizontal reference and an ascending or descending line of sight, placing the supplied angle at the observer.

answer.short: A $30^\circ$ angle below a horizontal reference line.
answer.worked: Draw a horizontal line through the observation point and a line of sight descending from that point. Label the angle between them $30^\circ$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 9(a); answer book PDF page 37 Q9(a)
spec.description: Upper-right observer, leftward horizontal ray, dashed extension right and line of sight descending left.
spec.mathematics: The depression angle between the horizontal and descending ray is 30 degrees.

answer.short: A $40^\circ$ angle above a horizontal reference line.
answer.worked: Draw a horizontal line through the observation point and a line of sight ascending from that point. Label the angle between them $40^\circ$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 9(b); answer book PDF page 37 Q9(b)
spec.description: Lower-left observer, rightward horizontal ray, dashed extension left and ascending line of sight.
spec.mathematics: The elevation angle between the horizontal and ascending ray is 40 degrees.
